Job Purpose :

To establish and strengthen the standardization, governance, and operational effectiveness of the Promotor workforce through the development of comprehensive playbooks, guidance rules, and standardized working procedures. This involves designing and maintaining Promotor operational guidelines, managing the deployment and utilization of new tools, and ensuring consistent implementation of standards across all regions and external partners (Vendor–DOP). This specialist defines the "Rules of Engagement," including recruitment profiles, training standards, uniform/kit specifications, and on-site behavior protocols. The role also supports regional teams in aligning administrative processes and maintaining accurate, consistent workforce data. The ultimate goal is to create a standardized, well-governed, and technology-enabled Promotor ecosystem that drives operational efficiency, execution consistency, and workforce productivity across all regions.

Main Responsibility:

1. Develop and Maintain Promotor Playbook & Operational Guidelines across all regions to ensure consistent execution standards, working procedures, role expectations, and governance of Promotor activities.
2. Lead New Tools Deployment, Delivery & Management by coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure Promotor tools are properly implemented, adopted, and utilized to improve operational effectiveness and workforce productivity.
3. Drive Promotor Standardization Across Regions and Partners by conducting regular alignment, socialization, and monitoring of standardized processes, policies, and operational guidelines across regional teams and external partners (Vendor–DOP).
4. Ensure Consistency of Promotor Operational Implementation by monitoring compliance with established standards, identifying gaps in execution across regions and vendors, and driving corrective actions to improve operational quality and consistency.
5. Act as PIC for Promotor Tools & System Coordination by collaborating with Touchpoint, IT, and other relevant stakeholders to manage system requirements, resolve operational issues, and ensure system functionality supports Promotor business needs.
6. Drive Continuous Improvement of Promotor Processes & Tools by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, strengthen operational governance, and enhance tool effectiveness to support better workforce management and sales execution.
7. Drating the specifications for promotor "Uniforms" and "Sales Kits" (ID cards, tablets, branded booths) and ensuring nationwide compliance with these specs.
8. Writing the Standard Operating Procedures for on-site activities, such as how to set up a kiosk, how to handle a device demo, and how to report daily activities.

Employment Status:

Permanent

Job Summary

Responsible for supporting digital transformation initiatives within Finance Shared Service through application support, system issue resolution, and data management and analysis. • Perform data reconciliation across systems, identify discrepancies, and investigate data anomalies.
• Support system implementation and rollout activities, including coordination, progress monitoring, documentation, and follow-up on action items.
• Prepare periodic reports, analytical reports, and dashboards to support business monitoring and decision-making.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree (S1) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Work Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in application support, system support, data analysis, or related fields.

Technical Skills:

• SQL and Database Management
• ETL and Data Processing; Python knowledge is an advantage.

• Incident, Problem, and Change Management
• Microsoft 365 and SharePoint
• Power BI and Data Visualization

Soft Skills:

• Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving
• Attention to Detail

• Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
• Time Management and Multitasking
• Proactive and Adaptable

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
